# Order

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Order`](gmeow-Order.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Order>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A purchase order or sales order — an agreement between a buyer and a seller for the supply of goods or services at a stated price. A subclass of [`Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md).
